lessons.title: Hello and Goodbye

items.exampleMeaning: Good afternoon, how's it going for you?

lessons.tip: Use 'hola' for friendly greetings. 'Adiós' is for saying goodbye. Remember to use 'buenos días' in the morning, 'buenas tardes' in the afternoon, and 'buenas noches' at night.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Hello, I am good, thank you.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Buenos días, estoy un poco cansado.
dialogue.meaning: Good morning, I am a little tired.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Adiós, que tengas un buen día.

scenario.partnerRole: You are a friendly person who greets someone.
scenario.brief: Saluda a la otra persona y pregúntale cómo está.
scenario.goal: You need to greet the person and ask how they are.

lessons.title: My Name Is...
lessons.tip: Use 'me llamo' to introduce your name. To ask someone their name, use '¿cómo te llamas?'. 'Encantado/a' is a polite way to express that you are pleased to meet someone.

scenario.partnerRole: You are a friendly person asking for names.
scenario.brief: Pregúntale a la otra persona su nombre y di el tuyo.
scenario.goal: You need to introduce yourself and ask for their name.

lessons.title: Where Are You From?
lessons.tip: Use 'soy' to say who you are. 'Eres' is used for informal situations when talking to someone directly. 'Es' is for he, she, or it.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: And you, where are you from?

scenario.partnerRole: You are asking someone where they are from.
scenario.learnerRole: You are answering and talking about your origin.
scenario.brief: Pregúntale a la otra persona de dónde es y di de dónde eres tú.
scenario.goal: You need to ask where they are from and tell them your origin.

lessons.title: Nice to Meet You!

items.exampleMeaning: It is a pleasure to meet you.
I am not badly, thank you.

lessons.tip: Use 'gusto' to express pleasure. When asking someone how they are, use '¿cómo estás?'. You can reply with 'bien', 'mal', or 'regular' depending on how you feel.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: I am well, thank you. And you?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: It is a pleasure to meet you.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Likewise, it is a pleasure to meet you.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: How is it going for you?

scenario.partnerRole: You are having a friendly conversation.
scenario.learnerRole: You are responding to greetings and asking how the other person is.
scenario.brief: Responde a la otra persona y pregunta cómo le va.
scenario.goal: You need to respond to their greeting and ask how they are.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Hola, estoy bien. Me llamo María.
dialogue.meaning: Hello, I am good. My name is María.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Encantado de conocerte, María. ¿De dónde eres?
dialogue.meaning: Nice to meet you, María. Where are you from?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: I am from Peru. And you?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: I am from Mexico. How are you?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: I am okay, thank you. And you?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: I am well. Goodbye, see you later.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Adiós, que tengas un buen día.

scenario.partnerRole: You are having a friendly conversation with someone you just met.
scenario.learnerRole: You are introducing yourself and getting to know the other person.
scenario.brief: Usa saludos, presenta tu nombre y pregunta sobre su origen y cómo están.
scenario.goal: You need to greet, introduce your name, and ask about their origin and how they are.
